Sliced ​​Beef Brisket Vegetable Salad

800g beef brisket, 40g water parsley stems,

1 cucumber, 1/4 carrot, 1/2 onion,

4 tablespoons mustard, 3 tablespoons kelp broth,

2 Cheongyang peppers, 1 red pepper
